entries.speaker: Demon

entries.speaker: Demon

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: King Yama
entries.en: So you've come! Wonderful.

entries.speaker: King Yama
entries.en: My name is King Yama. Whatever[n]happens in this land of torment[n]is my doing.

entries.speaker: King Yama
entries.en: First off, I'll have you choose either[n]odd or even.

entries.speaker: King Yama

entries.speaker: King Yama

entries.speaker: King Yama

entries.speaker: King Yama
entries.en: Now then, this is the first round.[n]Even or odd... Which do you choose?

entries.speaker: King Yama

entries.speaker: King Yama
entries.en: So you're going with even? The dice[n]shall decide your fate.

entries.speaker: King Yama
entries.en: Now then, let us begin!

entries.speaker: King Yama
entries.en: Hrgh, y-you won!?

entries.speaker: King Yama
entries.en: It seems as though your fate...[n]has not yet come to an end.

entries.speaker: King Yama
entries.en: The world of the living is nothing but[n]suffering... I hope you have the strength[n]to survive it!

entries.speaker: King Yama
entries.en: Now... Our three-round battle has[n]come to its conclusion...
